task: Search for a seafood paella recipe on Allrecipes with a minimum of 4.5 stars rating and at least 50 reviews. The recipe should include shrimp and mussels. Provide the ingredients, total time, and an overview of the preparation steps.
answer: Selected seafood paella recipe: Spanish Paella (Paella I) — https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/12728/paella-i/ — Rating: 4.7 stars from 178 ratings (meets the >=4.5 stars and >=50 reviews constraints; the Allrecipes search page offers no rating/review filter controls, so constraints were verified from the recipe page). Includes shrimp and mussels. Total Time: 1 hr 30 mins (90 mins). Ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil; 1 onion, chopped; 2 cloves garlic, minced; 1 red bell pepper, chopped; 4 ounces Spanish chorizo, diced; 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cubed; 1 (12 ounce) package uncooked Arborio rice; 5 cups chicken broth; 0.5 cup white wine; 1 sprig fresh thyme; 1 pinch saffron; salt and ground black pepper to taste; 2 squid, cleaned and cut into 1-inch pieces; 2 tomatoes, seeded and chopped; 0.5 cup frozen green peas; 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined; 1 pound mussels, cleaned and debearded; 0.25 cup chopped Italian flat-leaf parsley; 8 lemon slices for garnish. Preparation overview: Step 1 — Heat oil in a paella pan over medium heat; sauté onion, garlic, and pepper, then add chorizo, chicken, and rice; cook, stirring. Step 2 — Check rice doneness and stir in additional stock as needed. Step 3 — Stir in squid, tomatoes, and peas; cook 2 minutes, arrange shrimp and mussels on top, cover with foil for 3–5 minutes. Step 4 — Remove foil, scatter parsley, and serve garnished with lemon wedges.
